===== .cache/translation-analysis/view-probe.go SHA256 780006c0c437ef4313a51ec33b80f4f477724706d095a22ddd602be9cd3e2251 =====
// Ignored, hash-pinned diagnostic. This is not a production hardener pass.
package main

import (
 "bytes"
 "crypto/sha256"
 "encoding/hex"
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "go/ast"
 "go/format"
 "go/parser"
 "go/token"
 "os"
 "strings"
)

var pure=map[string]bool{}
var serial int
var reload bool
type record struct { Function string; Line, Statements, Accesses int }
var records []record

func view(x ast.Expr) bool {
 s,ok:=x.(*ast.SelectorExpr); if !ok || s.Sel.Name!="memory" {return false}
 i,ok:=s.X.(*ast.Ident); return ok&&i.Name=="m"
}
func expr(x ast.Expr) bool {
 switch x:=x.(type) {
 case *ast.Ident,*ast.BasicLit:return true
 case *ast.ParenExpr:return expr(x.X)
 case *ast.UnaryExpr:return x.Op!=token.AND&&x.Op!=token.ARROW&&expr(x.X)
 case *ast.BinaryExpr:return expr(x.X)&&expr(x.Y)
 case *ast.SelectorExpr:
  i,ok:=x.X.(*ast.Ident);return ok&&i.Name=="m"&&(x.Sel.Name=="memory"||x.Sel.Name=="g0")
 case *ast.IndexExpr:return view(x.X)&&expr(x.Index)
 case *ast.CallExpr:
  i,ok:=x.Fun.(*ast.Ident);if !ok||!pure[i.Name]||x.Ellipsis.IsValid(){return false}
  for _,a:=range x.Args{if !expr(a){return false}};return true
 }
 return false
}
func statement(s ast.Stmt) bool {
 switch s:=s.(type) {
 case *ast.AssignStmt:
  if s.Tok!=token.ASSIGN&&s.Tok!=token.DEFINE{return false}
  for _,l:=range s.Lhs {
   switch l:=l.(type){case *ast.Ident:if l.Name=="m"{return false}
   case *ast.SelectorExpr:if l.Sel.Name!="g0"||!expr(l){return false}
   case *ast.IndexExpr:if !view(l.X)||!expr(l.Index){return false}
   default:return false}
  }
  for _,r:=range s.Rhs{if !expr(r){return false}};return true
 case *ast.ExprStmt:
  c,ok:=s.X.(*ast.CallExpr);if !ok{return false};i,ok:=c.Fun.(*ast.Ident)
  return ok&&strings.HasPrefix(i.Name,"store")&&expr(c)
 }
 return false
}
func accesses(s ast.Stmt) (int,bool) {
 n,write:=0,false
 ast.Inspect(s,func(node ast.Node)bool{
  if x,ok:=node.(ast.Expr);ok&&view(x){n++}
  if c,ok:=node.(*ast.CallExpr);ok{if i,ok:=c.Fun.(*ast.Ident);ok&&strings.HasPrefix(i.Name,"store"){write=true}}
  if a,ok:=node.(*ast.AssignStmt);ok{for _,l:=range a.Lhs{if i,ok:=l.(*ast.IndexExpr);ok&&view(i.X){write=true}}}
  return true
 });return n,write
}
func replace(x ast.Expr,name string) ast.Expr {
 if view(x){return ast.NewIdent(name)}
 switch x:=x.(type){case *ast.ParenExpr:x.X=replace(x.X,name)
 case *ast.UnaryExpr:x.X=replace(x.X,name)
 case *ast.BinaryExpr:x.X=replace(x.X,name);x.Y=replace(x.Y,name)
 case *ast.IndexExpr:x.X=replace(x.X,name);x.Index=replace(x.Index,name)
 case *ast.CallExpr:for i,a:=range x.Args{x.Args[i]=replace(a,name)}}
 return x
}
func rewrite(s ast.Stmt,name string){switch s:=s.(type){case *ast.AssignStmt:for i,x:=range s.Lhs{s.Lhs[i]=replace(x,name)};for i,x:=range s.Rhs{s.Rhs[i]=replace(x,name)}
 case *ast.ExprStmt:s.X=replace(s.X,name)}}
func block(b *ast.BlockStmt,fs *token.FileSet,fn string){
 original:=b.List;var out []ast.Stmt
 for i:=0;i<len(original); {
  if !statement(original[i]){out=append(out,original[i]);i++;continue}
  end,n,write:=i,0,false
  for end<len(original)&&statement(original[end]){a,w:=accesses(original[end]);n+=a;write=write||w;end++}
  first:=i;for first<end{a,_:=accesses(original[first]);if a!=0{break};out=append(out,original[first]);first++}
  if n>=2&&write {
   serial++;name:=fmt.Sprintf("cocoonProbeView%d",serial)
   out=append(out,&ast.AssignStmt{Lhs:[]ast.Expr{ast.NewIdent(name)},Tok:token.ASSIGN,Rhs:[]ast.Expr{&ast.SelectorExpr{X:ast.NewIdent("m"),Sel:ast.NewIdent("memory")}}})
   records=append(records,record{fn,fs.Position(original[first].Pos()).Line,end-first,n})
   changed:=make([]ast.Stmt,0,end-first)
   for j,s:=range original[first:end]{
    a,_:=accesses(s)
    if reload&&j>0&&a>0 {changed=append(changed,&ast.AssignStmt{Lhs:[]ast.Expr{ast.NewIdent(name)},Tok:token.ASSIGN,Rhs:[]ast.Expr{&ast.SelectorExpr{X:ast.NewIdent("m"),Sel:ast.NewIdent("memory")}}})}
    rewrite(s,name);changed=append(changed,s)
   }
   out=append(out,changed...);i=end;continue
  }
  out=append(out,original[first:end]...);i=end
 };b.List=out
}

 if view(x){return ast.NewIdent(name)}
 switch x:=x.(type){case *ast.ParenExpr:x.X=replace(x.X,name)
 case *ast.UnaryExpr:x.X=replace(x.X,name)
 case *ast.BinaryExpr:x.X=replace(x.X,name);x.Y=replace(x.Y,name)
 case *ast.IndexExpr:x.X=replace(x.X,name);x.Index=replace(x.Index,name)
 case *ast.CallExpr:for i,a:=range x.Args{x.Args[i]=replace(a,name)}}
 return x
}
func rewrite(s ast.Stmt,name string){switch s:=s.(type){case *ast.AssignStmt:for i,x:=range s.Lhs{s.Lhs[i]=replace(x,name)};for i,x:=range s.Rhs{s.Rhs[i]=replace(x,name)}
 case *ast.ExprStmt:s.X=replace(s.X,name)}}

   records=append(records,record{fn,fs.Position(original[first].Pos()).Line,end-first,n})

}

leaves += [('matched',selector('BenchmarkSketchMatchedBatch',c,'N'+str(n),'Facade')) for c,n in [('Repeated',1024),('Holdout',8192)]]
leaves += [('guest',selector('BenchmarkSketchAddLayers','Guest'))]
allrows={}
for roundname,duration in [('screen','500ms'),('confirm','1s')]:
 for n in range(1,8):
  ordered=leaves if roundname=='screen' else leaves[::-1]
  for family,query in ordered:
   selected=roles[:] if n%2 else roles[::-1]
   if roundname=='confirm':selected=selected[::-1]
   if family=='guest':selected=[r for r in selected if r!='reference']
   if family=='stream':selected=['before']
   for role in selected:
    binary=out/('stream.test' if family=='stream' else role+'.test')
    args=[str(binary),'-test.run=^$','-test.bench='+query,'-test.benchtime='+duration,'-test.count=1','-test.benchmem']
    result=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,env=env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    rows=[line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('Benchmark')]
    assert len(rows)==1,(query,role,result.stdout)
    row=rows[0];fields=row.split()
    if family in ['holdout','corpus','matched','stream']:
     actual=float(fields[fields.index('actual-procs')-1]);assert actual==(16 if family=='stream' else 1),row
    allrows.setdefault((roundname,role,fields[0]),[]).append(float(fields[fields.index('ns/op')-1]))
    with (out/('narrow-'+roundname+'-'+family+'-'+role+'.txt')).open('a') as log:
     print('ROUND',n,datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),file=log)
     print('COMMAND',json.dumps(args),file=log);print(result.stdout,file=log,flush=True)
  print('PASS',roundname,n,flush=True)
 for binary in binaries:assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==prov['sha256'][str(binary.relative_to(root))]
 for (r,role,name),values in allrows.items():
  if r==roundname:print('MEDIAN',r,role,name,statistics.median(values),'ns/op',flush=True)
 print('COMPLETE',roundname,flush=True)
print('PASS isolated paired rounds, frozen binaries',flush=True)

===== .cache/translation-analysis/summarize.py SHA256 147adb0304bfe5a07a9ebe75d4f94275eed78f227c94da60151981dd5126a066 =====
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,re,statistics
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'.cache/translation-analysis';roles=['before','view','reload','reference']
summary={}
for roundname in ['screen','confirm']:
 table={}
 for family in ['original','holdout','corpus','matched','guest','stream']:
  available=['before'] if family=='stream' else [r for r in roles if r!='reference'] if family=='guest' else roles
  for role in available:
   path=out/(roundname+'-'+family+'-'+role+'.txt'); data=path.read_text()
   normalized=data.replace('pkg: cocoon.dev/cocoon/dd','pkg: dario.cat/cocoon/examples/datadog/go/dd')
   comparison=out/(roundname+'-'+family+'-'+role+'-normalized.txt');comparison.write_text(normalized)
   for line in data.splitlines():
    if not line.startswith('Benchmark'):continue
    fields=line.split();name=fields[0];metrics={fields[i]:float(fields[i-1]) for i in range(3,len(fields),2)}
    row=table.setdefault(name,{}).setdefault(role,{'ns':[],'metrics':{}})
    row['ns'].append(metrics['ns/op'])
    for key,value in metrics.items():row['metrics'].setdefault(key,[]).append(value)
  if family in ['original','holdout','corpus','matched','guest']:
   args=['/home/dario/go/bin/benchstat',*[str(out/(roundname+'-'+family+'-'+role+'-normalized.txt')) for role in available]]
   for suffix,fmt in [('benchstat.txt',[]),('benchstat.csv',['-format=csv'])]:
    with (out/(roundname+'-'+family+'-'+suffix)).open('w') as log, (out/(roundname+'-'+family+'-'+suffix+'.warnings')).open('w') as warnings:subprocess.run([args[0],*fmt,*args[1:]],stdout=log,stderr=warnings,check=True)
 for name,row in table.items():
  for role,values in row.items():
   assert len(values['ns'])==7,(roundname,name,role,values['ns'])
   values['median_ns']=statistics.median(values['ns'])
   values['median_metrics']={k:statistics.median(v) for k,v in values['metrics'].items()}
   if 'before' in row:values['delta_percent']=100*(values['median_ns']/statistics.median(row['before']['ns'])-1)
 summary[roundname]=table
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
for name,row in summary['confirm'].items():
 print(name,' '.join(role+':'+format(v['median_ns'],'.4g')+'ns'+('('+format(v.get('delta_percent',0),'+.2f')+'%)' if role!='before' else '') for role,v in row.items()))

===== .cache/translation-analysis/narrow-summarize.py SHA256 a91dedb3041f35fcddda615ff426f0bd79b17018907bbaae6ffb05a732671b89 =====
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,re,statistics
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'.cache/translation-analysis';roles=['before','view','fn176','epilogue','batch-export']
summary={}
for roundname in ['screen','confirm']:
 table={}
 for family in ['original','matched','guest']:
  available=['before'] if family=='stream' else [r for r in roles if r!='reference'] if family=='guest' else roles
  for role in available:
   path=out/('narrow-'+roundname+'-'+family+'-'+role+'.txt'); data=path.read_text()
   normalized=data.replace('pkg: cocoon.dev/cocoon/dd','pkg: dario.cat/cocoon/examples/datadog/go/dd')
   comparison=out/('narrow-'+roundname+'-'+family+'-'+role+'-normalized.txt');comparison.write_text(normalized)
   for line in data.splitlines():
    if not line.startswith('Benchmark'):continue
    fields=line.split();name=fields[0];metrics={fields[i]:float(fields[i-1]) for i in range(3,len(fields),2)}
    row=table.setdefault(name,{}).setdefault(role,{'ns':[],'metrics':{}})
    row['ns'].append(metrics['ns/op'])
    for key,value in metrics.items():row['metrics'].setdefault(key,[]).append(value)
  if family in ['original','holdout','corpus','matched','guest']:
   args=['/home/dario/go/bin/benchstat',*[str(out/('narrow-'+roundname+'-'+family+'-'+role+'-normalized.txt')) for role in available]]
   for suffix,fmt in [('benchstat.txt',[]),('benchstat.csv',['-format=csv'])]:
    with (out/('narrow-'+roundname+'-'+family+'-'+suffix)).open('w') as log, (out/('narrow-'+roundname+'-'+family+'-'+suffix+'.warnings')).open('w') as warnings:subprocess.run([args[0],*fmt,*args[1:]],stdout=log,stderr=warnings,check=True)
 for name,row in table.items():
  for role,values in row.items():
   assert len(values['ns'])==7,(roundname,name,role,values['ns'])
   values['median_ns']=statistics.median(values['ns'])
   values['median_metrics']={k:statistics.median(v) for k,v in values['metrics'].items()}
   if 'before' in row:values['delta_percent']=100*(values['median_ns']/statistics.median(row['before']['ns'])-1)
 summary[roundname]=table
(out/'narrow-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
for name,row in summary['confirm'].items():
 print(name,' '.join(role+':'+format(v['median_ns'],'.4g')+'ns'+('('+format(v.get('delta_percent',0),'+.2f')+'%)' if role!='before' else '') for role,v in row.items()))

def run(name,args,extra=None):
 with (out/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
  print('COMMAND',json.dumps(args),file=log,flush=True)
  subprocess.run(args,env=env if extra is None else dict(env,**extra),stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)

for gate in ['check','race','rust','cross','smoke','fuzz','integration']:

===== .cache/translation-analysis/reference-bin-reuse_test.go SHA256 d5f93c5ea4242533303416476b94172ce0c4866fe2f80024c56934fe32f4c97b =====
package dd

import (
	"math"
	"runtime"
	"testing"
)

const binReuseCorpusSize = 8192

var binReuseCorpora = []string{"Repeated", "UniqueCycle", "NearbyUniqueCycle", "MostlyUniqueCycle", "Phases", "BroadHoldout", "NegativeBins"}

// Freeze these inputs before selecting a cache. All finite corpora repeat after
// 8,192 points in timed loops; the separate Increasing control never repeats.
func binReuseValues(corpus string) []float64 {
	values := make([]float64, binReuseCorpusSize)
	negative := negativeBinSketchValues()
	for index := range values {
		switch corpus {
		case "Repeated":
			values[index] = 42
		case "UniqueCycle":
			values[index] = float64(index + 1)
		case "NearbyUniqueCycle":
			values[index] = math.Float64frombits(math.Float64bits(42) + uint64(index)) // #nosec G115 -- The index is bounded by the corpus size.
		case "MostlyUniqueCycle":
			values[index] = float64(1_000_000 + index)
			if index%16 == 0 {
				values[index] = 42
			}
		case "Phases":
			values[index] = float64(1_000_000 + index)
			if index/1024%2 == 0 {
				values[index] = float64(40 + index%16)
			}
		case "BroadHoldout":
			// An odd multiplier permutes the 52-bit mantissa; unique indices
			// cannot repeat a value even when their exponents coincide.
			mantissa := uint64(index+1) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 & ((1 << 52) - 1) // #nosec G115 -- The index is positive and bounded.
			exponent := uint64(723 + index*37%601)                             // #nosec G115 -- Exponents are in [723, 1323].
			values[index] = math.Float64frombits(exponent<<52 | mantissa)
		case "NegativeBins":
			values[index] = negative[index%len(negative)]
		default:
			panic("unknown bin-reuse corpus")
		}
	}
	return values
}

func BenchmarkSketchBinReuse(b *testing.B) {
	for _, corpus := range append([]string{"Increasing"}, binReuseCorpora...) {
		b.Run(corpus, func(b *testing.B) {
			batchingProcessors(b, 1)
			sketch, _ := benchmarkSketch(b)
			values := binReuseValues("UniqueCycle")
			if corpus != "Increasing" {
				values = binReuseValues(corpus)
			}
			// Warm the store with one corpus, including collapse for the
			// broad holdout. UniqueCycle stresses the cache capacity.
			for _, value := range values {
				if err := sketch.Add(value); err != nil {
					b.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			index := 0
			before := 0
			b.ReportAllocs()
			b.ResetTimer()
			for b.Loop() {
				value := values[index&(binReuseCorpusSize-1)]
				if corpus == "Increasing" {
					value = float64(binReuseCorpusSize + index + 1)
				}
				if err := sketch.Add(value); err != nil {
					b.Fatal(err)
				}
				index++
			}
			b.StopTimer()
			batchingMetrics(b, 1, 1, before, 0)
			if count, err := sketch.Count(); err != nil || count != float64(b.N+len(values)) {
				b.Fatalf("count=%g, want=%d: %v", count, b.N+len(values), err)
			}
		})
	}
}


func benchmarkSketch(b *testing.B) (*Sketch, int64) {
 b.Helper();library:=open(b);sketch,err:=library.NewSketch();if err!=nil {b.Fatal(err)}
 b.Cleanup(func(){if err:=sketch.Close();err!=nil {b.Error(err)}});return sketch,0
}
func batchingProcessors(b *testing.B, processors int) {
 b.Helper();previous:=runtime.GOMAXPROCS(processors);b.Cleanup(func(){runtime.GOMAXPROCS(previous)})
 if runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)!=processors {b.Fatal("actual processor mismatch")}
}
func batchingMetrics(b *testing.B, points, processors, before, after int) {
 b.Helper();if runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)!=processors {b.Fatal("actual processor mismatch")}
 b.ReportMetric(float64(processors),"actual-procs");b.ReportMetric(float64(points),"points/op")
 b.ReportMetric(float64(points)*float64(b.N)/b.Elapsed().Seconds(),"points/s")
}


===== .cache/translation-analysis/reference-matched_test.go SHA256 3255ce2b841519c711a134f686407413482226b17a1ad956fbf3393111f92718 =====
package dd
import ("fmt";"math";"runtime";"testing")
func batchingValues(corpus string, size int) []float64 {
	values := make([]float64, size)
	negative := negativeBinSketchValues()
	for index := range values {
		switch corpus {
		case "Repeated":
			values[index] = 42
		case "Nearby":
			values[index] = 1 + float64(index)/float64(max(size, 1))
		case "Unique":
			values[index] = float64(index + 1)
		case "NegativeBins":
			values[index] = negative[index%len(negative)]
		case "Holdout":
			// Deterministic, nonmonotonic, broad exponents and varied mantissas.
			values[index] = math.Ldexp(1+float64((index*7919+104729)%65521)/65521, index%601-300)
		}
	}
	return values
}


func BenchmarkSketchMatchedBatch(b *testing.B) {
for _,corpus:=range []string{"Repeated","Nearby","Unique","NegativeBins","Holdout"} {
for _,size:=range []int{1,32,1024,8192} {
for _,mode:=range []string{"Scalar","Facade"} {
b.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/N%d/%s",corpus,size,mode),func(b *testing.B){
previous:=runtime.GOMAXPROCS(1);b.Cleanup(func(){runtime.GOMAXPROCS(previous)})
library:=open(b);sketch,err:=library.NewSketch();if err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}
b.Cleanup(func(){if err:=sketch.Close();err!=nil{b.Error(err)}})
values:=batchingValues(corpus,size)
add:=sketch.AddMany
if mode=="Scalar" {add=func(vs []float64)error{for _,v:=range vs{if err:=sketch.Add(v);err!=nil{return err}};return nil}}
if err:=add(values);err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}
b.ReportAllocs();b.ResetTimer()
for b.Loop(){if err:=add(values);err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}}
b.StopTimer()
if runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)!=1{b.Fatal("actual processor mismatch")}
b.ReportMetric(1,"actual-procs");b.ReportMetric(float64(size),"points/op")
b.ReportMetric(float64(size)*float64(b.N)/b.Elapsed().Seconds(),"points/s")
if count,err:=sketch.Count();err!=nil||count!=float64(size)*float64(b.N+1){b.Fatal("count mismatch",count,err)}
})
}}}}

package dd

func negativeBinSketchValues() [8]float64 {

	}

		}

===== .cache/translation-analysis/reference-translation_test.go SHA256 5ba2cfb8e77b57425d301d9c3187e77634084555a70873c4595bdb7d8503cd4f =====
package dd

import (
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"

)

// These queries are held out from the original and varied SQL workloads. They
// cover longer scans, comments, escaped literals, Unicode, and quoted names.
func translationSQLQueries() []string {
	return []string{
		"/* route: warehouse */ SELECT \"item label\", amount FROM ledger WHERE note = 'it''s ready' AND amount >= -1.25e-9",
		"SELECT '世界', 'café', 9223372036854775807 FROM \"quoted table\" WHERE \"quoted column\" = 'mañana'",
		"WITH recent AS (SELECT event_id FROM event_log WHERE created_at > '2026-09-15') SELECT event_id FROM recent LIMIT 87",
		"SELECT object_id FROM archive WHERE object_id IN (" + strings.Repeat("17,23,41,59,", 128) + "83)",
		"UPDATE notes SET body = '" + strings.Repeat("quoted '' text 世界 ", 128) + "' WHERE note_id = 6701",
		"SELECT /* inline comment */ metric, value FROM readings -- trailing comment\nWHERE value BETWEEN 0.00017 AND 98765.4321",
	}
}

func BenchmarkObfuscateSQLTranslationHoldout(b *testing.B) {
	batchingProcessors(b, 1)
	library := open(b)
	queries := translationSQLQueries()
	index := 0
	b.ReportAllocs()
	b.ResetTimer()
	for b.Loop() {
		output, err := library.ObfuscateSQL(b.Context(), queries[index])
		if err != nil || output == "" {
			b.Fatalf("query %d produced %q: %v", index, output, err)
		}
		index = (index + 1) % len(queries)
	}
	b.StopTimer()
	if runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0) != 1 {
		b.Fatal("actual processor mismatch")
	}
	b.ReportMetric(1, "actual-procs")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(b.N)/b.Elapsed().Seconds(), "queries/s")
}


===== .cache/translation-analysis/reference-varied_test.go SHA256 83418403ba35153d90472814fe5647f209a52ee05dc191b5ec974edabb270736 =====
package dd

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// These varied inputs are held out from the PGO training benchmarks.
func variedSketchValues() [16]float64 {
	return [16]float64{
		0.01, 0.025, 0.125, 0.5,
		1.25, 3.75, 12.5, 42.25,
		100.5, 512, 1024.75, 8192,
		10000.25, 65536, 250000.5, 1000000,
	}
}

func variedSQLQueries() [8]string {
	return [8]string{
		"SELECT sku, price FROM catalog WHERE category = 'garden' AND price > 19.95",
		"SELECT shipment_id FROM shipments WHERE destination IN ('Oslo', 'Porto') AND priority = 3",
		"INSERT INTO audit_events (actor, action, sequence_no) VALUES ('operator-a', 'login', 8127)",
		"INSERT INTO stock_levels (sku, available) VALUES ('widget-42', 96)",
		"UPDATE invoices SET paid = true, memo = 'wire-transfer' WHERE invoice_no = 7351",
		"UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - 7 WHERE location = 'north-bin' AND product_id = 643",
		"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE account_id = 902 AND token = 'expired-token'",
		"DELETE FROM temp_readings WHERE station = 'ridge' AND recorded_at < '2026-01-01'",
	}
}

func BenchmarkSketchAddVaried(b *testing.B) {
	library := open(b)
	sketch, err := library.NewSketch()
	if err != nil {
		b.Fatal(err)
	}
	b.Cleanup(func() {
		if closeErr := sketch.Close(); closeErr != nil {
			b.Error(closeErr)
		}
	})
	values := variedSketchValues()
	index := 0
	b.ReportAllocs()
	b.ResetTimer()
	for b.Loop() {
		if addErr := sketch.Add(values[index]); addErr != nil {
			b.Fatal(addErr)
		}
		index = (index + 1) % len(values)
	}
	b.StopTimer()
	if count, countErr := sketch.Count(); countErr != nil || count != float64(b.N) {
		b.Fatalf("point count = %g, want %d: %v", count, b.N, countErr)
	}
}

func BenchmarkObfuscateSQLVaried(b *testing.B) {
	library := open(b)
	queries := variedSQLQueries()
	index := 0
	b.ReportAllocs()
	b.ResetTimer()
	for b.Loop() {
		output, err := library.ObfuscateSQL(b.Context(), queries[index])
		if err != nil || output == "" {
			b.Fatalf("query %d produced %q: %v", index, output, err)
		}
		index = (index + 1) % len(queries)
	}
}

func TestVariedBenchmarkCorpus(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	library := open(t)
	sketch, err := library.NewSketch()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if closeErr := sketch.Close(); closeErr != nil {
			t.Error(closeErr)
		}
	})
	values := variedSketchValues()
	for index, value := range values {
		if addErr := sketch.Add(value); addErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("value %d rejected: %v", index, addErr)
		}
	}
	if count, countErr := sketch.Count(); countErr != nil || count != float64(len(values)) {
		t.Fatalf("point count = %g, want %d: %v", count, len(values), countErr)
	}
	for index, query := range variedSQLQueries() {
		output, sqlErr := library.ObfuscateSQL(t.Context(), query)
		if sqlErr != nil || !strings.Contains(output, "?") {
			t.Fatalf("query %d produced %q: %v", index, output, sqlErr)
		}
	}
}

===== examples/datadog/go/dd/translation_bench_test.go SHA256 0b841a30218ae501994d04154ca8a0dc39369912a4ffb4f6bdd0905b8d098100 =====
package dd

import (
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"dario.cat/cocoon/cocoontest"
	"dario.cat/cocoon/rt"
)

// These queries are held out from the original and varied SQL workloads. They
// cover longer scans, comments, escaped literals, Unicode, and quoted names.
func translationSQLQueries() []string {
	return []string{
		"/* route: warehouse */ SELECT \"item label\", amount FROM ledger WHERE note = 'it''s ready' AND amount >= -1.25e-9",
		"SELECT '世界', 'café', 9223372036854775807 FROM \"quoted table\" WHERE \"quoted column\" = 'mañana'",
		"WITH recent AS (SELECT event_id FROM event_log WHERE created_at > '2026-09-15') SELECT event_id FROM recent LIMIT 87",
		"SELECT object_id FROM archive WHERE object_id IN (" + strings.Repeat("17,23,41,59,", 128) + "83)",
		"UPDATE notes SET body = '" + strings.Repeat("quoted '' text 世界 ", 128) + "' WHERE note_id = 6701",
		"SELECT /* inline comment */ metric, value FROM readings -- trailing comment\nWHERE value BETWEEN 0.00017 AND 98765.4321",
	}
}

func BenchmarkObfuscateSQLTranslationHoldout(b *testing.B) {
	batchingProcessors(b, 1)
	library := openTest(b, Options{Instances: 1})
	queries := translationSQLQueries()
	index := 0
	b.ReportAllocs()
	b.ResetTimer()
	for b.Loop() {
		output, err := library.ObfuscateSQL(b.Context(), queries[index])
		if err != nil || output == "" {
			b.Fatalf("query %d produced %q: %v", index, output, err)
		}
		index = (index + 1) % len(queries)
	}
	b.StopTimer()
	if runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0) != 1 {
		b.Fatal("actual processor mismatch")
	}
	b.ReportMetric(1, "actual-procs")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(b.N)/b.Elapsed().Seconds(), "queries/s")
}

func TestTranslationSQLHoldout(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	g, reference := newDifferential(t)
	library := openTest(t, Options{Instances: 1})
	for range 2 {
		for index, query := range translationSQLQueries() {
			status, expected := compareOperation(t, g, reference, "cocoon_obfuscate_sql", []cocoontest.Arg{{Buffer: true, Bytes: []byte(query)}})
			output, err := library.ObfuscateSQL(t.Context(), query)
			if status != rt.OK || len(expected) == 0 || err != nil || output != string(expected) {
				t.Fatalf("query %d: status=%d output=%q expected=%q: %v", index, status, output, expected, err)
			}
		}
	}
}

from pathlib import Path
import base64, collections, hashlib, json, re, subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
out = root / '.cache/translation-analysis'

# Compact only the comparisons. Every original sample/custom metric stays below.
comparison_files = []
for prefix, families, roles in [
    ('', ['original', 'holdout', 'corpus', 'matched', 'guest'],
     ['before', 'view', 'reload', 'reference']),
    ('narrow-', ['original', 'matched', 'guest'],
     ['before', 'view', 'fn176', 'epilogue', 'batch-export']),
]:
    for roundname in ['screen', 'confirm']:
        for family in families:
            paths = [out / (prefix + roundname + '-' + family + '-' + role + '-normalized.txt')
                     for role in roles if family != 'guest' or role != 'reference']
            target = out / (prefix + roundname + '-' + family + '-time-benchstat.txt')
            with target.open('w') as log:
                subprocess.run(['/home/dario/go/bin/benchstat', '-filter', '.unit:sec/op',
                                *map(str, paths)], stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
            comparison_files.append(target)

# Keep enough matching machine-code/SSA material to audit the demonstrated claim
# without duplicating 25k-line SQL disassemblies or all unsampled source listings.
inspection = out / 'inspection-excerpts.txt'
with inspection.open('w') as log:
    log.write('Selected excerpts from matching frozen binaries/dumps.\n'
              'Full original-artifact hashes below; excerpt locations are explicit.\n'
              'Go1.26.8 generated code, Go1.27.1 nm/objdump inspection tools.\n')
    for name in ['baseline.asm', 'before.asm', 'view.asm', 'reload.asm', 'epilogue.asm',
                 'before-batch.asm', 'view-batch.asm']:
        path = out / name
        data = path.read_bytes()
        log.write('\nSOURCE ' + name + ' SHA256 ' + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() + '\n')
        sections = re.split(r'(?=^TEXT )', data.decode(), flags=re.M)
        for section in sections:
            if not section.strip():
                continue
            lines = section.splitlines()
            if '.fn96(SB)' in lines[0]:
                selected = lines[:360]
                log.write('EXCERPT first360 lines of SQL function; initializer/header reloads.\n')
            elif '.fn176(SB)' in lines[0] or '.Xcocoon_sketch_add(SB)' in lines[0] or 'sketch_add_many(SB)' in lines[0]:
                selected = lines
                log.write('COMPLETE function disassembly.\n')
            else:
                continue
            log.write('\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in selected) + '\n')
    for path in sorted(out.glob('(*Module).*dump')):
        data = path.read_bytes()
        log.write('\nSOURCE ' + path.name + ' SHA256 ' + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() + '\n')
        lines = data.decode().splitlines()
        if '.fn176_' in path.name:
            log.write('COMPLETE fn176 SSA dump.\n')
            selected = lines
        else:
            log.write('EXCERPT first100 lines; full dump reproducible with archived flags.\n')
            selected = lines[:100]
        log.write('\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in selected) + '\n')
    for path in sorted(out.glob('*-lines.txt')):
        data = path.read_bytes()
        lines = data.decode().splitlines()
        selected = set(range(min(3, len(lines))))
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            columns = line.split(maxsplit=2)
            sampled = len(columns) == 3 and re.match(r'^\d+:', columns[2]) and columns[:2] != ['.', '.']
            if line.startswith('ROUTINE ') or sampled:
                selected.update(range(max(0, i-1), min(len(lines), i+2)))
        log.write('\nSOURCE ' + path.name + ' SHA256 ' + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
                  + '\nEXCERPT sampled lines and adjacent context, original file line numbers.\n')
        for i in sorted(selected):
            log.write(str(i+1) + ': ' + lines[i].rstrip() + '\n')

    for path in files:
        data = path.read_bytes()
        log.write('\n===== ' + str(path.relative_to(root)) + ' SHA256 '
                  + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() + ' =====\n')
        lines = []
        for line in data.decode().splitlines():
            leading = re.match(r'^[ \t]*', line).group()
            if ' \t' in leading:
                line = leading.expandtabs(8) + line[len(leading):]
            lines.append(line.rstrip())
        log.write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
    for path in sorted(out.glob('*.cpu')):
        data = path.read_bytes()
        encoded = base64.b64encode(data).decode()
        log.write('\n===== ' + str(path.relative_to(root)) + ' SHA256 '
                  + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() + ' BASE64 =====\n')
        log.write('\n'.join(encoded[i:i+76] for i in range(0, len(encoded), 76)) + '\n')
print('Archived', len(files), 'text artifacts and5 binary CPU profiles;', archive.stat().st_size, 'bytes', flush=True)
